}}{{TIDTOC|adapter}} ==Overview== The AKiTiO Thunder3 10G Network Adapter was a bus-powered Thunderbolt 3 to 10G Ethernet adapter. It was designed for Thunderbolt 3 capable notebooks like the MacBook Pro (late 2016) and professional workstations that require reliable, accelerated access to external storage and networks for I/O demanding applications.
